correctness.rationale: Direct forbidden-face uniqueness kills allowed paths of length >=3 and forces the m-1 differences of the two routes across each square as the entire invariant 2-chain space. Thus dim Omega=(2m,3m-2,m-1). On square differences the first boundary has a unique top horizontal edge coefficient -1, hence rank m-1; its second boundary is (xi+xi^2)(b_{i+1}-t_i), rank m-1 for primitive order N>=3 and zero for N=2. Weighted edge incidence has one-dimensional left nullspace lambda(w)=-xi lambda(v), hence rank 2m-1. Substituting ranks into the N-differential quotient reproduces each q and the N=2,3 boundary cases. Independent modular path/forbidden-face and incidence calculations checked 20 pairs of ladder length and root order over F_13, not the infinite proof.
residual_risks: The finite-field tests verify only 20 parameters, not all complex roots; the proof relies on unique forbidden faces and exact weighted incidence.
